ATT_ACC_COMP.desc: Enable/disable acceleration compensation in attitude estimation (centripetal, tangential).

ATT_BIAS_MAX.desc: Gyro bias limit for the attitude estimator.

ATT_MAG_DECL.desc: Magnetic declination, set automatically if ATT_MAG_DECL_A is enabled.

ATT_MAG_DECL_A.desc: Automatic magnetic declination lookup from GPS position.

ATT_VIBE_THRESH.desc: Vibration threshold that triggers a warning/failsafe reaction.

BAT_CAPACITY.desc: Battery capacity; -1 disables capacity-based remaining-charge estimation.

BAT_CRIT_THR.desc: Critical battery threshold (fraction of full charge that triggers critical failsafe).

BAT_C_OFFSET.desc: Battery current sensor analog offset/calibration; -1 = use board default.

BAT_C_SCALING.desc: Battery current sensor analog scaling factor; -1 = use board default.

BAT_LOW_THR.desc: Low battery threshold (fraction of full charge that triggers low-battery failsafe).

BAT_N_CELLS.desc: Number of battery cells in series.

BAT_V_LOAD_DROP.desc: Voltage drop compensation per battery cell under full load.

BAT_V_SCALING.desc: Battery voltage sensor analog scaling factor; -1 = use board default.

CAL_ACC0_ID.desc: Device ID of accelerometer #0 used for the stored calibration below.

CAL_ACC_PRIME.desc: Device ID of the primary (preferred) accelerometer.

CAL_GYRO0_ID.desc: Device ID of gyroscope #0 used for the stored calibration below.

CAL_GYRO_PRIME.desc: Device ID of the primary (preferred) gyroscope.

CAL_MAG0_ROT.desc: Rotation of magnetometer #0 relative to the airframe/hull (-1 = use board default).

CAL_MAG1_ROT.desc: Rotation of magnetometer #1 relative to the airframe/hull.

CAL_MAG2_ROT.desc: Rotation of magnetometer #2 relative to the airframe/hull.

CAL_MAG_SIDES.desc: Bitmask of which of the 6 cube sides were completed during onboard mag calibration.

CBRK_AIRSPD_CHK.desc: Circuit breaker: disable airspeed sensor check (irrelevant underwater; fixed-wing leftover).

CBRK_BUZZER.desc: Circuit breaker: disable the buzzer/tone alarm.

CBRK_ENGINEFAIL.desc: Circuit breaker: disable the engine/motor failure detection check.

CBRK_GPSFAIL.desc: Circuit breaker: disable the GPS failure check (expected to be disabled — no GPS underwater).

CBRK_IO_SAFETY.desc: Circuit breaker: disable the IO safety switch requirement before arming.

CBRK_NO_VISION.desc: Circuit breaker: disable the requirement for vision/optical-flow position source.

CBRK_RATE_CTRL.desc: Circuit breaker: disable the rate controller (dangerous — motors would run open-loop).

CBRK_SUPPLY_CHK.desc: Circuit breaker: disable the power supply health check.

CBRK_USB_CHK.desc: Circuit breaker: disable the "USB connected, refuse to arm" safety check.

COM_AUTOS_PAR.desc: Parachute deployment on auto mission failure (fixed-wing feature, likely unused).

COM_DISARM_LAND.desc: Time after landing detection before auto-disarm; 0 disables.

COM_DL_LOSS_T.desc: Data link (telemetry) loss timeout before triggering failsafe.

COM_DL_REG_T.desc: Data link regain time required before clearing the data-link-lost failsafe.

COM_EF_C2T.desc: Engine failure: current-to-throttle ratio threshold used for failure detection.

COM_EF_THROT.desc: Engine failure: throttle threshold above which the check is active.

COM_EF_TIME.desc: Engine failure: time above threshold before it is flagged as failed.

COM_HOME_H_T.desc: Horizontal threshold for accepting a new home position.

COM_HOME_V_T.desc: Vertical threshold for accepting a new home position.

COM_LOW_BAT_ACT.desc: Action to take when the low-battery threshold is crossed.

COM_RC_LOSS_T.desc: RC signal loss timeout before the RC-lost failsafe triggers.

DEEP_SENSOR_ID.desc: Device ID of the depth/pressure sensor in use.

DRIVE_DEEP_P.desc: P-gain of the depth-hold ("drive to target depth") controller.

EKF2_REC_RPL.desc: EKF2 replay logging mode (this drone appears to use the legacy INAV estimator, so likely unused/vestigial).

FW_AIRSPD_TRIM.desc: Fixed-wing trim airspeed — vestigial parameter from the shared PX4 codebase, not applicable to a sub.

GF_ACTION.desc: Action to take on geofence breach.

GF_COUNT.desc: Number of geofence polygon points loaded (NaN = none loaded).

GF_MAX_HOR_DIST.desc: Max horizontal distance from home before geofence breach (NaN = disabled).

GF_MAX_VER_DIST.desc: Max vertical distance from home before geofence breach (NaN = disabled).

INAV_DISAB_MOCAP.desc: Disable use of motion-capture position input.

INAV_FLOW_DIST_X.desc: Optical flow sensor X offset from vehicle center of gravity.

INAV_FLOW_DIST_Y.desc: Optical flow sensor Y offset from vehicle center of gravity.

INAV_FLOW_Q_MIN.desc: Minimum optical flow quality accepted as valid.

INAV_LIDAR_OFF.desc: Rangefinder offset from ground/expected reading at zero altitude.

INAV_W_GPS_FLOW.desc: Estimator weight: blending GPS with optical flow velocity.

INAV_W_XY_FLOW.desc: Estimator weight: horizontal position/velocity from optical flow.

INAV_W_XY_GPS_P.desc: Estimator weight: horizontal position from GPS.

INAV_W_XY_GPS_V.desc: Estimator weight: horizontal velocity from GPS.

INAV_W_XY_RES_V.desc: Estimator weight: horizontal velocity residual/reset gain.

INAV_W_XY_VIS_P.desc: Estimator weight: horizontal position from vision.

INAV_W_XY_VIS_V.desc: Estimator weight: horizontal velocity from vision.

INAV_W_Z_BARO.desc: Estimator weight: vertical position from barometer (repurposed for depth/pressure on this sub).

INAV_W_Z_GPS_P.desc: Estimator weight: vertical position from GPS.

INAV_W_Z_GPS_V.desc: Estimator weight: vertical velocity from GPS.

INAV_W_Z_LIDAR.desc: Estimator weight: vertical position from rangefinder.

INAV_W_Z_VIS_P.desc: Estimator weight: vertical position from vision.

MAV_COMP_ID.desc: MAVLink component ID this system reports itself as.

MAV_FWDEXTSP.desc: Forward external setpoint messages over MAVLink.

MAV_RADIO_ID.desc: ID of a specific radio/telemetry system to bind MAVLink handling to (0 = any/none).

MAV_SYS_ID.desc: MAVLink system ID (matches "target_system" used throughout the cockpit).

MAV_TEST_PAR.desc: Internal test parameter, no functional effect.

MAV_TYPE.desc: MAVLink MAV_TYPE reported in HEARTBEAT (numeric vehicle type code).

MAV_USEHILGPS.desc: Use simulated (Hardware-In-the-Loop) GPS instead of a real GPS receiver.

MC_ACRO_P_MAX.desc: Max pitch rate commanded by the stick in ACRO/manual-rate mode.

MC_ACRO_R_MAX.desc: Max roll rate commanded by the stick in ACRO/manual-rate mode.

MC_ACRO_Y_MAX.desc: Max yaw rate commanded by the stick in ACRO/manual-rate mode.

MC_PITCH_P.desc: Pitch angle controller P gain (outer loop).

MC_RATT_TH.desc: Threshold between manual rate mode and attitude-stabilized mode.

MC_ROLL_P.desc: Roll angle controller P gain (outer loop). 0.0 here likely means roll-hold is disabled on this hull.

MC_YAWRAUTO_MAX.desc: Max yaw rate during autonomous/auto-heading control.

MC_YAW_P.desc: Yaw angle controller P gain (outer loop).

MIS_DIST_1WP.desc: Max allowed distance to the first waypoint (sanity check).

MIS_LTRMIN_ALT.desc: Minimum loiter altitude used during auto missions.

MIS_TAKEOFF_ALT.desc: Default takeoff altitude for auto missions.

MIS_YAW_ERR.desc: Max yaw error accepted before considering a waypoint yaw achieved.

MIS_YAW_TMT.desc: Max time allowed to reach the desired mission yaw; -1 disables the timeout.

NAV_AH_ALT.desc: Altitude used for the "safe/rally" auto home point.

NAV_AH_LAT.desc: Latitude of the "safe/rally" auto home point (irrelevant underwater — no GPS).

NAV_AH_LON.desc: Longitude of the "safe/rally" auto home point (irrelevant underwater — no GPS).

NAV_DLL_AH_T.desc: Time before datalink-loss failsafe switches to the auto/safe home point.

NAV_DLL_CHSK.desc: Datalink-loss: use "critical" home point instead of standard home.

NAV_DLL_CH_LON.desc: Longitude of the critical/emergency home point for datalink loss.

NAV_DLL_CH_T.desc: Time before switching to the critical/emergency home point.

NAV_DLL_N.desc: Number of datalink-loss cycles/attempts before final action.

NAV_GPSF_LT.desc: GPS-failure failsafe: loiter time before further action.

NAV_GPSF_P.desc: GPS-failure failsafe: manual throttle/pitch used during descent.

NAV_GPSF_R.desc: GPS-failure failsafe: roll angle used during the fallback maneuver.

NAV_GPSF_TR.desc: GPS-failure failsafe: throttle used during the fallback maneuver.

NAV_LOITER_RAD.desc: Loiter/circle radius used in auto modes.

NAV_RCL_LT.desc: Time before RC-loss failsafe switches to the auto/safe home point.

PARK_DEEP_I.desc: I-gain of the depth-hold ("park at depth") controller.

PARK_DEEP_P.desc: P-gain of the depth-hold ("park at depth") controller.

PARK_DEEP_THRUST.desc: Thrust limit/authority allotted to the depth-hold ("park") controller.

PV_BOARD_ID.desc: Identifier of the specific PV flight-controller board/hardware revision.

PV_INTOWATER.desc: Water-immersion/leak sensor state or threshold (config-side twin of PV_V_INTOWATER).

PV_SPEEDADJUST.desc: Global speed-scaling factor applied on top of the L/M/H gear selection.

RC_ACRO_TH.desc: RC switch threshold for engaging ACRO (manual rate) mode.

RC_ASSIST_TH.desc: RC switch threshold for engaging assisted flight mode.

RC_AUTO_TH.desc: RC switch threshold for engaging auto/mission mode.

RC_CHAN_CNT.desc: Detected number of active RC input channels.

RC_DSM_BIND.desc: Spektrum DSM satellite receiver bind command trigger (NaN = idle).

RC_FAILS_THR.desc: RC failsafe throttle threshold used to detect signal loss.

RC_KILLSWITCH_TH.desc: RC switch threshold for engaging the kill switch (immediate motor stop).

RC_LOITER_TH.desc: RC switch threshold for engaging loiter mode.

RC_MAP_ACRO_SW.desc: RC channel mapped to the ACRO mode switch (0 = unassigned).

RC_MAP_AUX1.desc: RC channel mapped to AUX passthrough output 1.

RC_MAP_FLAPS.desc: RC channel mapped to flaps (fixed-wing leftover, unused on this sub).

RC_MAP_FLTMODE.desc: RC channel mapped to the flight-mode selector switch.

RC_MAP_KILL_SW.desc: RC channel mapped to the kill switch.

RC_MAP_LOITER_SW.desc: RC channel mapped to the loiter-mode switch.

RC_RETURN_TH.desc: RC switch threshold for engaging return-to-launch.

RTL_DESCEND_ALT.desc: Altitude at which RTL switches from cruise to final descent.

RTL_LAND_DELAY.desc: Delay before landing once RTL reaches home; -1 disables auto-land (loiter instead).

RTL_MIN_DIST.desc: Minimum distance from home below which RTL climbs directly instead of cruising.

RTL_RETURN_ALT.desc: Altitude used during the RTL cruise/return leg.

SDLOG_GPSTIME.desc: Wait for a valid GPS time before starting a new log file.

SDLOG_PRIO_BOOST.desc: Priority boost given to the logging thread.

SDLOG_UTC_OFFSET.desc: UTC time offset applied to log file timestamps.

SENS_BARO_QNH.desc: Barometer sea-level pressure reference (irrelevant underwater; fixed-wing/altitude leftover).

SENS_BOARD_ROT.desc: Rotation of the flight-controller board relative to the vehicle body/hull.

SENS_BOARD_X_OFF.desc: Board mounting X-axis offset correction, in degrees.

SENS_BOARD_Y_OFF.desc: Board mounting Y-axis offset correction, in degrees.

SENS_BOARD_Z_OFF.desc: Board mounting Z-axis offset correction, in degrees.

SENS_DPRES_ANSC.desc: Differential pressure sensor analog scale (airspeed sensor, fixed-wing leftover).

SENS_DPRES_OFF.desc: Differential pressure sensor offset (airspeed sensor, fixed-wing leftover).

SYS_AUTOCONFIG.desc: Trigger automatic reset of all parameters to airframe defaults.

SYS_AUTOSTART.desc: Airframe/vehicle configuration preset ID applied at first boot.

SYS_MC_EST_GROUP.desc: Selected position/attitude estimator group (0 = legacy INAV/LPE estimator, matching the INAV_* params seen here).

SYS_PARAM_VER.desc: Parameter definition schema version, used to detect/convert outdated parameter sets.

SYS_RESTART_TYPE.desc: Type of the most recent restart (0=normal power-cycle, 1=in-air, 2=data-loss).

VT_NAV_FORCE_VT.desc: VTOL: force multicopter mode during RTL/mission regardless of transition state (vestigial, VTOL-only feature).

VT_OPT_RECOV_EN.desc: VTOL: enable optimal recovery during back-transition (vestigial, VTOL-only feature).

VT_TYPE.desc: VTOL airframe type (vestigial, VTOL-only feature — this sub is neither a plane nor VTOL).

VT_WV_LND_EN.desc: VTOL: enable wind-vane weathervaning during landing (vestigial, VTOL-only feature).

VT_WV_LTR_EN.desc: VTOL: enable wind-vane weathervaning during loiter (vestigial, VTOL-only feature).

VT_WV_YAWR_SCL.desc: VTOL: weathervaning yaw rate scale (vestigial, VTOL-only feature).

_HASH_CHECK.desc: Internal parameter-file integrity hash used by PX4 to detect out-of-sync parameter definitions; not user-meaningful.
